A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
a non-coding genetic variant in TP53 alters cancer susceptibility conferred in tissue-specific manner by microRNA expression.
the TP53 variant rs78378222 is associated with cancer susceptibility and its mechanism is dependent upon the tissue-specific expression of microRNAs.
the TP53 noncoding polymorphism rs78378222 is associated with differential microRNA expression and p53 protein levels in specific tissues.

the same genetic variant can be a risk factor for one cancer and a protective factor for another.
